articles.summary: ORLANDO, FL — On January 22, 2026, Massimo Group (NASDAQ: MAMO) took center stage at the PGA Show to unveil its second-generation MVR HVAC Pro Series. The Texas-based manufacturer is redefining the "fair-weather" reputation of golf carts by introducing fully enclosed cabins with integrated heating and air conditioning.
